dt: Faculty nominations due Dec 11, 2026, 5 pm CST; awards around end of January 2027 for a July 1, 2027 start
e: Two-year fellowship in electronic and photonic materials, energy materials, environmental materials or automated materials discovery. Candidates are nominated by a tenure-track Rice faculty member in RAMI and need a PhD from July 2025 or later with at most two years of prior postdoc; non-US citizens must be eligible for J-1 status.
f: Rice Advanced Materials Institute (RAMI), Rice University
n: Rice University: RAMI Postdoctoral Fellowship Program (2027)
unv: Opening date not shown; nomination only, no direct applications.
